content.text: Production-ready 2D pixel art for a fixed-camera three-quarter top-down dark fantasy dungeon game. Match the supplied Overbless pixel-art references: crisp hard pixel clusters, readable silhouette at 128 pixels, dark navy outlines, restrained cyan/purple/orange accents, no antialiasing, no blur, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark. Use a perfectly flat pure magenta #ff00ff background around every isolated object. Create a strict 4-column by 2-row sprite sheet with eight separate isolated Echo blessing assets, one asset centered in each equal cell with wide magenta gutters. Top row left to right: 1) Echo HUD seal icon, angular double-chevron rune; 2) tiny enemy overhead Echo status icon; 3) translucent-looking doubled humanoid silhouette mask rendered as solid purple pixel clusters; 4) delayed straight attack telegraph with two parallel edges and a small repeat notch. Bottom row left to right: 5) delayed circular shockwave telegraph with double ring; 6) Echo application burst, mirrored rune fragments around an empty center; 7) overblessed resonance aura ring with three outward spikes; 8) resonance arrival floor sigil. Purple and pale violet only with dark navy outlines. Every cell must contain exactly one asset, no text, no borders, no labels.
